style: Say warmly with a gravelly voice, like an old park ranger telling stories
lines: Our book has a beginning, a middle and an end. Tap Who, choose a character, then tap a page.
Now, where does each part happen? Tap Where, choose a place, then tap a page.
That's a plan. Tap Make it.
Build this page. Tap Place, then add a character.
Your pictures are ready. Tap Background, then Action to choose the sounds.
Drag the piece. Use Size, Flip or Remove. Tap empty paper for the trays.
Tap Place to choose where this page happens. Then choose its sounds.
These sounds are the same. Tap two different sounds to hear a change.
These pages are the same. Tap Make to change a picture or sound first.
Tap another background chip to swap sounds.
Tap another action chip to swap sounds.
Tap another page number to swap whole pages.
Now give the page sounds. Pick a background sound and an action sound.
Tell the story out loud while the book plays. Tap Next page to turn.
The end. Now try Swap, and see what changes.
Drag a sound to another page to swap them. Or tap two page numbers.
Swapped! Tap Play. Is it a different story now?
Swap a background with a background, or an action with an action.
Four pieces is the most on a page.
Raccoon's Night Walk. Tap Play to hear the book.
A page is full. Tap Make and remove a thing, then choose Who again.
Tap a card. Then tap a page.
Tap a piece to change its pose, move it, or remove it.
Start a new book? Tap Yes, start new, or Keep my book.
Swap undone. Tap Play to hear your book again.
Piece removed. Tap Characters or Things to add another.
Tap Snap on page 2, then Snore on page 3.
Tap Make, page 2, then Action. Choose Thunder.
Tap page 1, then page 3 to swap whole pages.
Tap Make, page 2, then Background. Choose Crickets.

Listen to this page. Tap a sound to change what happens.
